_about: Retrieval/grounding eval set. kind: lexical = question reuses the paper's wording; paraphrase = same fact, different wording; unanswerable = on-topic but not in the paper (the LLM must refuse); out_of_scope = unrelated (the similarity gate should refuse). evidence: substrings, any of which must appear in a retrieved chunk (compared ignoring case and whitespace). answer_any: for --llm runs, the answer must contain one of these.
